balls.text: super bowling, full and flat and slapped to KP at cover for one
full and flat and square-driven to a tumbling KP at backward point
he too comes out but miscues the full toss over midwicket
makes room and skips out, van der Werwe fires it full and wide but Agarkar gets some bat on it, slashing down to third man for a single
too full down the pads and he paddles it away to the sweeper
gives him the charge and hits a rank full toss to cover where KP dives
gives himself room and carves the full ball through midwicket
attempted yorker outside off, Agarkar makes room and misses
attempted slower ball goes very wide of the stumps
full on the stumps and he squirts the ball away for a single
now there's a much better shot for the same result, he just gets across and plays a premeditated paddle to the fuller ball and with fine leg up thats all the way to the ropes
safest place to score your runs! PK keeps it nice and full, van Wyk drives with little footwork and gets a fine inside-edge that sneaks narrowly past leg stump
pitches outside off stump and Agarkar square-drives it away
shuffles about and ends up steering the ball square to the off side
holds back the length, gets some turn, steered down to third man

up comes Mark Benson's finger in a flash! van der Merwe flights it up slowly on the stumps, Lokhi is late on the sweep, the ball looks to have hit him pretty much in front and the umpire has few doubts
tosses it up full, thats driven hard into the covers for two more
fuller and flatter but he drives on the volley and into the covers
short and wide and cut out to the deep where Appanna fumbles
flat on the stumps and clipped away out to the sweeper
fired down leg stump and he gets a teeny bit of bat on that .. or not
spits up from outside off, does well to dab it fine for a single
another one to Kumble, sliding it down the pads, Saha gets too much under it and top-edges a forceful slow-sweep straight to KP, jogging to his right from backward point
slides down the pads, he kneels down and sweeps hard for two
uses his feet and drives the ball into the off side
elevation for Saha finally, skipping down and even though not to the pitch and nearly beaten in flight, he gets under the ball and heaves it over midwicket, just
tosses it up, gets lovely dip, van Wyk plays it to the off side
full in the blockhole, slower ball too, and played back to Appanna
full and flat down leg stump and swept away with superb placement
uses his feet, Appanna fires it wide, Saha chips in the air to mid-off
tosses it up, van Wyk waits in his crease and swats it past square
quicker ball, kicks up and he does well to get over it and run it fine
well done AK, tosses it up on a length and van Wyk defends
uses his feet to meet the ball, Kumble slows the pace, Saha clips fine
too straight and the result is a clip off the pads for two
well bowled, no room to work with so he comes onto the front foot and drives the ball toward extra cover for a quick single
slow outside off stump, no turn, he gets over it and chops it away
holds it back in the air a second later to surprise van Wyk, committed on the front foot, then he has to adjust and gets a leading edge into the gap between cover and point
waits to see if there's turn, there isn't, so he steers it fine for one
shuffles in his crease, Appanna fires it down leg, van Wyk sweeps
pitches on leg, turns in, Saha shuffles and on-drives a single
slower ball, not much turn, he makes room and squirts it to third man
too wide outside leg stump and he sweeps hard, top placement that
flat on the stumps and he watchfully plays it away
gets a long way forward, uses the wrists and steers to third man
comes forward and defends gently, getting a quick single to the off
strides well forward and knocks the ball away to the off side
tosses it up, Saha comes forward and rolls the wrists, KP dives across
tosses it up to bring out the cover drive, just a couple though
a tad too straight and he picks off a single to the leg side
gets some room and finds the gap square on the off side
flat on the stumps and turned away for one
aye, he's missed a stumping! Appanna comes around the stumps, flights it on a super length, gets some turn and beats the bat, van Wyk falls forward in playing the shot but Boucher fumbles the ball

gone! Gayle swings across to one gently flighted up, thinks he's found the gap but Goswami keeps his eyes on the ball running around from midwicket and takes the catch, falling over after doing so just for a bit of effect
starts off with one sliding down the pads, full toss, and he steers it fine
flat on the pads and again knocked away for a single
slower ball drifts down the pads and he clips it toward square, Gayle's runner calls for the single and gets home despite a direct hit
pitches outside leg, turns in sharply, Gayle turns it away for one
much wider and thus van Wyk can cut it behind backward point
slower ball, tossed up outside off, he opens the face and dabs it fine
flat on middle and leg and turned into the gap at midwicket
turn there from outside off stump, draws a healthy outside edge thats safe of slip and rolls down to third man for a couple
tosses it up, Gayle reaches out and gets an inside edge to midwicket
much fuller and flatter and he squeezes it into the covers for one
slower ball, cleverly done, holds back the length and van Wyk gets a leading edge that drops safely in front of cover
flat on the stumps, he goes back and punches it back straight
tossed up very wide and Gayle pads it away
stands tall again and punches firmly and picks out cover
good length outside off stump, back goes Gayle to punch to cover
off the mark immediately, opening the face and steering to third man

and the short ball works again, how many times in this man's career have we seen him succumb to that, even I've lost count! After the fuller slower ball, PK changes up with a short delivery on the stumps and Ganguly makes a real mess of that, just lobbing it over the infield and straight to the man running in from the deep midwicket boundary, easiest catch he'll get
lovely slower ball, on a length just about off stump or so, Ganguly tentatively comes forward and then plays the ball with soft hands to the point fielder
takes a step back and slices a short ball through cover and point
shortish again, he opens the face but cannot beat backward point
a tad quicker and much fuller on middle and leg and he defends
short and wide, sliding away, Gangs cuts and misses
fuller and flatter and he slogs again, this time with a bit of an inside edge but still finds the gap at square leg
catch is the call from someone as Gayle sizes up this gentle floater, clears the front leg, and slogs over midwicket but the ball drops safely and beats the running sweeper
slower ball, nearly a yorker length, Gayle jams it out with one hand
slips in a short ball, Ganguly tries to pull but then pulls out in the end
pitches it up and Gayle drives off the front foot toward mid-off
just back of a length outside off stump and steered to backward point
now he serves up room and Gayle bisects point and gully for one
good line and length again and Gayle pushes straight back
pitched up on a length, middle and off, and Gayle pushes it back
tossed up outside off to invite the drive and Ganguly pushes to cover
got em with the slider! Kumble flights it up on a length and the ball skids on to hit Hodge just around the knee roll, very late on the shot, and Mark Benson raises the finger
flipper, short on off stump and he defends it back
slower ball, flighted on middle and off and Gayle pushes to cover
a touch short and wide and he cuts off the back foot to point
ripper! Bounce and turn beats Gayle, pushing forward and the wrong 'un, which spits up and surprises Boucher too
well bowled and well run, PK hits a good length, Gayle doesn't move his feet much but plays with soft hands and scampers a single as the ball rolls to cover
good slower ball, middle and leg, and Gayle pats it back
sweetly timed, hitting the ball that angles in with power past mid-on
lovely slower ball, much fuller and Gayle has to defend
Gayle gets into position early to pull over midwicket but the lack of pace forces a rethink and he flat-bats a forehand back over the umpire's head ... ball slows down and mid-off chases
short of a length just around off stump, Gayle stands and defends
top shot that from Hodge, again using his feet to create room and this time he smashes a wide ball through cover for four to end the over
good comeback, back of a length on off stump and Hodge defends
again he exposes all the stumps and reaches out to slap a wide ball between cover and point for four
he's had enough and does a cute little two-step, collecting the ball on the volley after making room and chipping it high over extra cover
ah, well bowled, thats just a fraction fuller and sucking Hodge forward, he plays a nothing shot, surprised by the bounce, ball takes the shoulder of the bat and drops safely
pitches short of a length, Hodge gets up and inside-edges the pull
good ball to end the over, flat on middle and leg and Gayle defends
a tad short and he cuts from on top of off stump right to point
another bad ball, very wide down the pads, beats Boucher too
bad ball, a rank long hop which gets the Gayle treatment, it was so slow that ball, that he could have gone for a cup of tea before pulling that over midwicket
there's a mistimed shot, Hodge sweeping with the turn but nearly giving Kallis at square leg a catch, but the ball just evaded him
flatter, shorter, wider and he dabs it square on the off side
picks a slow turner from outside off and sweeps hard to square
hard shot that, just took it on the full and drove it past mid-off
well bowled, very flat, very full, no room and jammed out
flat on the pads and turned away through midwicket for one
another chip shot, uppish, between the gap at midwicket
there's the first boundary as Gayle just picks this with the spin, off the pads, and beats the sweeper out at deep square leg
flat from over the stumps, Gayle goes back and defends
tosses it up and Hodge hits back hard to KP on the bounce
flat on the pads and tucked away for a single
well bowled, KP! Slowly flighted on middle and leg, Gayle presses forward and gets beaten as the ball breaks away from the bat
first runs off the bat as Hodge works one off his pads
more sharp turn, pitches on middle and off and spins down leg
spins down the pads and thats called a wide

oh lord, whats happening! Its a first-baller! I've lost count of how many times this has happened this season! KP tosses it up outside off stump, McCullum cuts straight into the hands of the point fielder, who didn't have to move an inch
full toss down the leg stump and Boucher swats it away! He's been the man to guide them home after a collapse, and what an innings to seal a tense win
cool customer, is Boucher, making room to steer this past point, Ishant runs after it and the scores are level

fired in down leg, Boucher makes room and drives past extra cover, they settled for one but Gayle didn't collect it cleanly and the ball rolls down the track, Pandey scampers straight down the pitch and they get a couple
super shot under pressure! Boucher uses his feet and clips the full ball over midwicket and beats two men in the deep ... what a player
expectedly its full and flat and Pandey slogs it past midwicket
follows up with an attempted yorker but ends up full down leg stump, Pandey exposes all three sticks and connects well to punch the ball into the covers
another edge and a wicket! Roelof what are you doing? Ishant pitches it up on a length, Roelof shuts his eyes and plays a really bad shot, getting a thin edge through
mad swing and a miss! Reolof looks to square leg and swings it away, beaten all ends up by a clever slower ball, back of a length just outside off stump
fires it in full down the pads, Boucher clears his legs to clip it but ends up with a thin inside edge down to short fine leg
a mad waltz down from Roelof, who slogs a top edge over point
short of a length outside off and he clubs it down to long-on
good ball, slows it up and lands it on a length, defended back
walks down and takes it on the full, clipping out to deep midwicket
makes some room and cuts that through cover and point for two
super shot, dances down and deposits that over long-on for six
well bowled, spins away and the batsman gets a leading edge that rolls to Gayle at cover, who misfields needlessly and allows a single
full and flat, gets to the pitch and punches the ball down to long-on
uses his feet and dumps the last ball over long-on, great shot that
full and a bit wider, he frees the arms and square-drives past cover
fired in, patted back on the bounce, Gayle misfields but recovers
drifts onto middle stump and thats flicked away for a single
full and very flat, top delivery, and just squeezed to short covert
tossed up and thats watchfully played back to Gayle
oh what a mess this man KP has been for Bangalore! Shuffles about his crease, takes a step down and chips this up over mid-on, Saha runs in takes an easy catch
flat on the stumps, he gets across and chips it past midwicket

gone! Hodge gets another with a faster one that skids through to Kohli, who gets cheeky and tries to play a late dab but only threads a thin edge to van Wyk, taking another good catch when standing up to the stumps
flowing shot that, lovely shimmy down the track and thats over long-on
uses his feet, dances down, mistimes the clip to midwicket, who collects and has a throw but cannot nail a direct hit
flights it up, Kohli comes down and drives to extra cover
again he waits on the back foot, this time biffing just wide of mid-off
back of a length and he punches off the back foot past cover
pitches it up and thats driven on the rise into the gap at cover
slower ball outside off, he tries to work it away but plays it back to Dada
pitches it wide outside off stump, he gets back and drives past cover, out to Agarkar in the deep who fumbles and allows Kohli the second
what trash, a real half-tracker and thats pulled over midwicket firmly
tosses it up wider, gets some drift, and he checks the drive to point
drags it even shorter and Kohli pulls a couple out to the deep
drops a touch shorter and KP works it wide of midwicket

oh what a mess in the deep! KP shuffles and then Murali holds back the length, so he drives on the rise over cover, Dinda runs across from long-off but overruns it and cannot turn back in time, then he says well I will have a dive but thats four
good length that, KP was winding up but had to adjust to defend
tossed up on a length, Kohli punches to cover and calls KP across
walks across his stumps to sweep, cannot get bat on it, the ball is called wide but that was very close to hitting leg stump ... how can you call that wide?
good ball! Short and he gets good bounce to keep Kohli wary
pitches it up, gets some movement inside, KP drives down the ground

Kallis goes, looking to follow KP with a pull shot, fetching a shorter delivery from outside off stump but he was never in position to play that and van Wyk calls for the top edge and pouches it running across to his right
short of a length outside off stump, KP waits on the back foot and then turns it into the gap at square leg
comes forward and cracks a drive straight to short cover
gets across, drops his hands and dabs it down past gully
bad ball, short and wide and carved out to the deep cover fielder
gets across and sweeps hard with an inside edge to deep square
tossed up, he gets up and flicks it wide of midwicket
flat on the stumps and he goes back to work it to midwicket
full toss driven to the left of long-off, a fumble allows KP a second

and he strikes! A needless shot from Goswami, clearing the front leg and slogging one gently floated up outside off stump, and he gets the faintest of tickles which van Wyk does well to hold onto for a smart catch standing up ... Hodge jumps up and a good innings is over
quicker ball, turns back into Goswami who steers it to third man
tad too straight so he pushes it away for a single to deep square
teasing line and length and Kallis drives it back down the track
gets across early and paddles it down to Saha at fine leg
tosses it wide, Goswami drives across the line back to Murali
slowly flighted on the pads, turned with plenty of ease past midwicket
pitches on the stumps and he hits it uppishly past mid-on
much fuller on off stump and he nicely nudges it to midwicket
pulls off the front foot, over midwicket and out to the sweeper
back of a length, Kallis forces it away down to backward point
short again and this time he pulls it through midwicket
starts off short and Goswami firmly pulls behind square leg
fired in on the pads and he clips it through square leg for one more
errs in length and Goswami cuts but Shukla dives well at point
full on middle and leg, Kallis on-drives it down the ground for one
fuller and he drives off the front foot to mid-off
flighted on a good length and he defends
flat on the pads and he nudges it away for a single
slower ball, Kallis chips in the air over mid-on on the bounce to sweeper
comes onto the front foot and clips it across his front pad in the air
spears it down leg stump, Goswami sweeps but cant beat Gayle
flat on off stump and defended
has a flashy drive outside off and edges fine, keeper fumbles too
tosses it up full and Goswami plays it wide of Hodge to raise the fifty
short but Goswami doesn't spot it and just ends up dabbing a single
flatter on and about off stump and Kallis square-drives it away
premeditated paddle-sweep now, collecting on the full from off stump
lands it on a good length to get Goswami defending again
shorter and flatter and he punches off the back foot to cover
slowly tossed up outside off, Goswami comes forward and tries to get cheeky with the dab but gets beaten
now Kallis swings an ugly shot and just manages to beat midwicket
speared in, Kallis shuffles and drives, Gayle jumps across to stop
keeps hammering it in very flat and full and this is driven to extra cover
skips out but Gayle sees him and fires that in to draw a defensive
full and very flat, Goswami makes room and drives to cover
flat on off stump, up goes one leg as Kallis drives to long-on
flat on middle and leg and he plays it back
does a confident two-step and biffs this over Ganguly at extra cover
reaches out to drive but uses too much bottom hand, Murali fields it
uses his feet, Murali checks the length, then Goswami pats it away
lovely shimmy down the track and lofts him over mid-on's head
tosses it up, Goswami comes well forward and pushes to cover
again he opens the face and runs it down to third man for one
onto the front foot, gently playing the ball to backward point
slower ball, brings Goswami onto the front foot and then he steers it
now he drops short and Goswami pulls in front of square
too wide down the pads this time
thats a tee-off down the ground, no footwork but just relying on back lift to swing it over mid-on, drops safely and rolls across the boundary rope
full again and he uses the wrists well, squirting it through gully
full and very wide, Goswami plays a booming square drive and misses
uses his feet and drives it through the covers with power and placement
back of length on the stumps and he drags it down to midwicket
hops up and plays the ball down with soft hands, runs a single, there's an overthrow to boot and McCullum does the saving

hops across to well outside off stump to try and knock the ball to the leg side, doesn't get much timing and scampers down the track, Kallis says where'd you think you're off to boy and orders him back, Goswami has to hurry back and dives just in time
pitches outside leg stump and shapes in, Goswami pats it back
pitches on the stumps and he shuffles to turn the ball away
stands his ground and reaches out to steer it past gully
down leg stump and another wide from Ajeetey
fuller on leg stump and clipped to the man at midwicket
well finally Goswami gets bat on ball and its four! He sees the room on offer, makes a bit more room, and drives that over extra cover
serves it up full, Kallis kneels down and chases and gets a French cut
good ball, attempted yorker which Kallis manages to get bat on
Kallis square-drives the wide half-volley but cant beat point
and lo and behold he starts off with a swinging wide outside off stump
pitches just outside leg stump, swings a touch, Goswami shuffles to try and play it away but the ball gets big on him and balloons up, Ishant runs in to take
now Goswami makes room and flashes hard but still can't connect
third ball in a row Goswami fishes outside off stump and gets beat, Ishant has hit a testing line here and the angle across and extra bounce is working well
flirts again at a slower ball that angles across, gets beat here too
beats him first ball by pitching this one up and angling it across, gets some good bounce and Goswami chases loosely
much fuller outside off, Kallis defends off the front foot and gets one
starts off spraying it down the pads and Saha gets into action to take
